edges: Income-tax Act 2025 replaces the 1961 Act from 1 April 2026
Defines reverse charge as recipient's liability under 9(3)/9(4)
Notified goods/services taxed on reverse charge
RCM on purchases from unregistered suppliers by notified registered persons
E-commerce operator pays tax on notified services
GTA services (not opted for forward charge) are under RCM
Legal services by advocate to business entity are under RCM
Director's services to company are under RCM
Recipient body corporate pays tax on GTA/legal/sponsorship services
RCM liability must be paid in cash, not through ITC
Recipient is the person liable to pay tax under RCM
Persons liable under RCM must register compulsorily
TDS deductors under Section 51 must register
Raises threshold to Rs 40 lakh for exclusive goods suppliers
Recipient under RCM from unregistered supplier issues self-invoice
Composition dealer is not entitled to any ITC
Issues bill of supply, cannot collect tax
ITC only if supplier furnished invoice in GSTR-1
Reverse ITC if supplier not paid within 180 days
No ITC after 30 Nov following the FY or annual return
Tax paid under composition is blocked for buyer
Tax paid under Section 74 demands is blocked
Notifies 18% for wrongly availed and utilised ITC
Interest on tax paid late in GSTR-3B
Interest when ITC wrongly utilised or reversed
Freight / carriage of goods is 'work' under 194C
No TDS if transporter owns <=10 goods carriages and gives PAN declaration
30% of freight/contract payment disallowed if TDS default
30% of professional fees disallowed if TDS default
TDS must be paid by due date of return u/s 139(1)
No tax audit if presumptive income declared
Different regimes: GST TDS (2%) vs income-tax TDS - do not confuse
